lines.text: Answer in one word. What did you do all day Sunday?
Football. He means football. Good morning. I am the football from the backyard.
One word. Where were you at noon?
There is a shape of him in the cushion now. It is very accurate. It has his mustache.
The couch has one for you.
That is not a number, Darnell.
Forty two. I counted. I had nothing else to do. I am a ball.
That is one word. Well done.
Why is there ranch on the ceiling?
He threw the cup up. The cup came down. The ranch stayed up there. It lives there now.
Did you yell at the television?
He told a grown man in a helmet to use his eyes. Eleven times. In a whisper. Then a scream.
Did the man use his eyes?
Okay. Your fantasy team. One word. How did it go?
He named his team The Couch Kings. The Couch Kings lost to a team called The Gutters.
The Gutters scored one hundred and nine points. He scored forty. Like the wings, but less.
That is two words. I will allow it. It is a roof thing he promised to clean on Sunday.
Who is the only person who would name a team The Gutters?
Yes. I joined your league in September. You sent me the link. You thought I was your cousin.
Marcus is in Ohio. I am in first place.
She picked her players while you were asleep on the couch. Very quietly. With a snack.
I read the names. I picked the ones that sounded fast.
Sure. Next Sunday. Loser cleans the gutters.
He has agreed to clean the gutters. In one word. I have never been prouder.
Last question. One word. Who is the best player in this house?
I will hold the ladder. I have no hands. It will be emotional support.
